title.narrative: BT IDF for Bhutan Public Expend. Mgmt

description.narrative: RGOB requested June 2005 that the Bank prepare a DPL and the activities to be supported by IDF are likely to become an important component of the operation. The IDF grant will help the RGOB meet its public expenditure management objectives and ensure that public spending has maximal development impact and bolster its fiscal management. The proposed activities to be supported by an IDF dovetail with ongoing ESW activities, including preparation of country economic update, a series of planned fiscal studies and a TA effort leading up to a fiscal report. The initiatives are expected to improve public expenditure management in the shortrun, as well as begnning a process that will seek consistent improvements over the medium term. This will lead to stronger fiscal discipline, greater transparancy and greater development impact from public expenditure. In January 2005 workshops were conducted by the MOF and Bank for senior officials from across the government a well as technical government staff to help generate a better understanding of what is involved in implementing an MTEF as part of efforts to improve public expenditure management. The grant approved on June 28, 2005, will be executed by the Government of Bhutan . The proposed grant of $300,000 will provide advisory and traning services to RGOB for improving fiscal management Proposed activities are as follows: 1) Facilitate the development of a Medium Term Fiscal Framework (MTEFF). 2) Strengthen the institutional linkages for macroeconomic framework coordination and improved macroeconomic forecasts. 3) Build capacity for revenue forecasting within an MTEF. 4) Enhance transparency and improving/developing a website in the Ministry of Finance. Strategic Objectives: Assist Government of Bhutan to improve its MTFF as a first concrete step towards the operationalization of its planned MYRBs and enhance transparency. Ms. Ananya Basu took over the task leadership from Mr. Christian Eigen-Zucchi effective 02/10/09. The objective of the grant is to assist the Royal Government of Bhutan (RGoB) in strengthening its public expenditure management, focusing on improving the overall planning and budget process. This will help in (a) bolstering overall fiscal discipline, and (b) enhancing the effectiveness of public expenditure. The grant will facilitate progress towards these goals by helping the RGoB: * Develop and progressively strengthen a Medium Term Fiscal Framework (MTFF), as a first step towards establishing an MTEF; * Bolster the institutional linkages needed for better macroeconomic framework coordination and the preparation of macroeconomic forecasts; * Build capacity for revenue forecasting within an MTFF; * Enhance transparency and develop/improve a website in the Ministry of Finance. The expected outcomes of the IDF grant are the strengthening of public expenditure management in the short-run, as well as the bolstering of a process that will seek consistent improvement over the medium term, leading to stronger fiscal discipline, greater transparancy and greater development impact from public expenditures.
